title: The Inca road network stretched over 30,000 km
body: The Qhapaq Nan, the Inca road network, reached its peak in the 15th century CE. It linked communities across the Andes, with roadside buildings where travellers could stay and supplies could be stored.
takeaway: Preserving the network now takes cooperation across six South American countries.
source: UNESCO World Heritage Committee, Qhapaq Nan inscription (2014)
visual: a stone-paved Inca road winding across a steep Andean mountainside towards a distant mountain pass
